checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'content-marketing'.

checks.description: Hub routes to editorial-calendar, article-brief, and content-distribution.
checks.rule: Body references all three sub-skills by name: editorial-calendar, article-brief, content-distribution.

checks.description: Hub assembles the content-package with the exact body fields.
checks.rule: Output section names editorial_calendar, article_briefs[], distribution_plan, and open_items.

checks.description: Hub briefs and routes copy to copywriters, does not write final copy.
checks.rule: Body states article_briefs[] route to copywriter-ar and copywriter-en for authoring, and the content-marketer does not write final copy.

checks.description: Hub builds the plan on the seo-package clusters and the strategy angle.
checks.rule: Body consumes the strategy-artifact angle and the seo-package keyword_map and content_briefs.

checks.description: Hub states the gate stack in order: skill eval, language copy QA, brand-qa-reviewer.
checks.rule: Body lists skill eval, then arabic-copy-qa / english-copy-qa, then brand-qa-reviewer, per verification.md.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: Hub instructs reading offers, claims, and titles from the brief, never inventing.
checks.rule: Body states offers, prices, claims, Skill Path titles, and instructor names come from the brief or context, and the skill stops and asks when absent.
